remettreEx.r1_t: Don't get back together with your ex
remettreEx.r1_d: At least one of your answers mentions fear, violence or threats. In that case, the rest doesn't count anymore: what scared you doesn't disappear with a breakup, or with promises made to get you back. What you still feel for them is real, but it doesn't make going back safe for you.
remettreEx.r1_a: Talk to someone today. In the UK, the National Domestic Abuse Helpline (0808 2000 247) answers for free, 24 hours a day; in the US, the National Domestic Violence Hotline is 1-800-799-7233. In immediate danger, call 999 or 911. And if your ex threatens to hurt themselves to get you back, that's not yours to carry alone: tell the people close to them, and in an emergency, call 999 or 911.
remettreEx.r2_d: Almost all your answers point the same way: what split you up is still there, and several things show this relationship was doing you more harm than good. Missing them is real, but it isn't enough to make a good couple. And if you felt put down or controlled, or were afraid of how they'd react even once, that's not a detail.
remettreEx.r2_a: Don't make a decision on an evening when you miss them. Keep your distance for a while, surround yourself with people, and ask those close to you what they saw of your relationship: they often noticed things before you did.
remettreEx.r3_d: Some things matter between you, but the heart of the problem hasn't moved: the reason for the breakup is still there, or it's just covered up by promises. Going back now means risking the same story, with the same ending. And if you've already broken up several times, that risk is even higher.
remettreEx.r3_a: Ask to see before you believe: actions, over several weeks, not words. If nothing changes during that time, you'll have your answer.
remettreEx.r4_d: The basics are there, but something's missing: an honest conversation about what would be different, time to see whether the changes hold, or a wish that comes from both of you equally. Nothing is closed, but saying yes now would be moving a bit fast.
remettreEx.r4_a: Go back over the questions where you hesitated: that's where you'll find what needs sorting out before starting again. And talk about it with your ex, getting specific.
remettreEx.r5_t: Yes, but with your eyes open
remettreEx.r5_d: A lot of things are going the right way: what split you up has changed or is changing, you want the same life, and you're not going back just so you won't be alone. A second try has a good chance, as long as you don't pick up exactly where you left off.
remettreEx.r5_a: Before getting back together, agree on two or three specific things to do differently. And take your time: nothing forces you to pick everything back up at once.
remettreEx.r6_t: Yes, the conditions for a second try are there
remettreEx.r6_d: Almost everything is going the right way: what split you up is in the past, you both own your part, and it really is them you miss, not just life as a couple. The people close to you aren't against it, and you can picture yourself happy together a year from now. That's exactly what you want to see before starting over!
remettreEx.r6_a: Enjoy it, without forgetting what the breakup taught you. Keep talking about what's bothering you before it turns into an argument: that's often what was missing the first time.
